about: The roofer with failures: the plan call with photos is rejected (400, an image the API cannot open), so the route retries without images (plan-noimages.json); the outline fails (500) so Contact is laid out from its recipe; Roof Replacement (p3) is overloaded (529) and Roof Repair (p4) is rate-limited (429, retry-after 2 s). A replay fixture answers the same way every time, so both fail on every attempt; the other pages answer as in the default set.
